name: LendLoop 03 — Error workflow (set as Error Workflow for 01 & 02)

parameters.content:
## LendLoop — workflow 3: error workflow

Import this workflow, copy its ID, and paste it as the **Error Workflow** in the Settings of workflows 01 and 02 (their exports contain the placeholder `REPLACE_WITH_ERROR_WORKFLOW_ID`).

On any failure it POSTs a signed record to Convex `POST /n8n/error-logged`, so automation failures are visible next to the lending data instead of only in n8n logs.
